title: Synthesis and molecular structure of Nd5(μ5-O)(μ3-OR)2(μ2-OR)6(OR)5(ROH)2 (R = Pri). The first example of a trigonal bipyramidal metal oxoalkoxide

synthesis.procedure: Under dry argon using vacuum-line or Schlenk techniques, neodymium chips (23 g, 0.159 mol) were activated with mercuric salts [HgCl2 + Hg(OAc)2 (1:1, 15 mg) or Hg(OAc)2 only] in 300 cm3 of toluene/isopropanol (1:1) and heated under reflux for 48 h. Filtration of the hot reaction medium and cooling to room temperature afforded a first crop of pale blue, air-sensitive crystals of 1. Isopropanol was dried by distillation over [Al(OPri)3]4.

synthesis.procedure: From the same reflux reaction of neodymium chips (23 g, 0.159 mol) activated by mercuric salts in 300 cm3 toluene/isopropanol (1:1) for 48 h, a second crop of crystals of the oxoisopropoxide solvate 2 was obtained by adding isopropanol (100 cm3) to the filtrate (250 cm3) after isolation of 1.
